_readme: Ratcheted by scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs. modulesObserved may only rise; modulesWithZeroCoverage may only fall. To move a number the wrong way, edit it here in the same commit and add a line to justifications saying why.
_note: modulesWithZeroCoverage was 152 in the first baseline. It is 98 here not because tests were added but because the ratchet stopped counting type-only modules, which TypeScript erases and V8 therefore cannot instrument. 75 reachable modules are type-only. The earlier 152 was an over-count.
_note2: 2026-08-02: modulesObserved 392 -> 393 and record-only line coverage 21.3% -> 35.6% on the addition of tests/room/portalVisibility.test.mjs, which builds both immersive scenes through their own compose* lists rather than importing a handful of prop factories. One extra MODULE, a third more LINES: the gap between those two numbers is the whole reason this ratchet gates modules and only records lines.
_note3: 2026-08-02: 393 -> 394 on kitchen/decor/leftWallCabinets.ts, the new left-wall cabinetry. It is reached because the Kitchen's decor barrel composes it, which is the property worth having a number for: a piece of scenery that was authored and never composed would leave this at 393 and would also show up as a `dead` export in noUnusedExports.
_note4: 2026-08-02: 394 -> 395 on utils/scene/perchSurfaces.ts, the owl's landing-surface framework. Only ONE module for a change that touches the owl, three rooms and the shared floor-tap wiring, because the rule was deliberately put in one pure module with no owl and no scene in it — which is what let tests/room/owl-perch-surfaces.test.mjs sweep it over 3,721 floor points per room.
_note5: 2026-08-02: 395 -> 396 on utils/scene/rotationRange.ts, which took the camera’s azimuth clamp off the scene catalog and made it derivable. The module it replaced was a field in a config object, so this is one module for a rule that previously had no home and no test.
_note6: 2026-08-02: 396 -> 483 observed and 98 -> 16 zero-coverage, which is NOT 87 new modules of testing. Every earlier figure in this file was recorded from a SUBSET glob; this is the first baseline taken over the full tests/** run the CI job actually executes, so the two are not comparable and the jump is a measurement change, not a coverage change. The ratchet still only lets the numbers move one way from here. utils/scene/stageRect.ts is the one genuinely new module in this commit.

lineCoverageRecordOnly.note: NOT gated — nondeterministic, see the docblock in scripts/coverage-ratchet.mjs
